title: leucanthemum graminifolium
intro: Leucanthemum graminifolium, commonly known as the grass-leaved oxeye daisy, is a flowering plant species within the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum graminifolium are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display potential antiviral and antibacterial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
